name: Detailed tool settings affect painting while composition guides leave artwork unchanged
description: Choosing a wider Pen brush through the detailed inspector changes its painted footprint, while enabling a composition overlay and hiding panels do not change the saved artwork.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the local PixiBun Studio at a 1440 by 900 desktop viewport.
Open Tool settings with Pen active.
Set Brush size to four pixels.
Choose Diagonals in the Composition selector.
Restore panels using the visible Restore panels button.
Verify the brush stroke has a visibly four-pixel-wide footprint and the top quick control agrees with the detailed brush size setting.
Verify the canvas pixels are unchanged by the guide and focus controls; diagonals remain a view overlay rather than painted pixels.
